gentium.notes: SIL; version 7.000 is the successor of Gentium Plus (Gentium Plus 6.200 was the last Plus release). Egyptological transliteration is a stated design goal.

gentium-book.notes: Heavier, book-weight sibling of Gentium (successor of Gentium Book Plus).

charis.notes: SIL; successor of Charis SIL; Bitstream Charter based, sturdy and bold-friendly.

doulos.notes: Times-like. Regular only: no bold or italic.

andika.notes: Sans-serif; control only, not a serif candidate.

junicode.notes: Static TTF Regular/Italic/Bold/BoldItalic from the 2.226 zip; medievalist font with a large Latin Extended-D coverage.

noto-serif.notes: Variable (wdth,wght) from google/fonts at a pinned commit. Bold comes from the weight axis.

eb-garamond.notes: Variable (wght) from google/fonts at a pinned commit.

cardo.notes: Scholarly font by David Perry; no bold italic.

stix-two-text.notes: Times-like (the closest to the quote's current system serif on macOS). Variable (wght) from google/fonts at a pinned commit.

new-athena-unicode.notes: Society for Classical Studies; v5.008. Download page says OFL applies to the TTF and to the woff for web developers. Names Demotic/Egyptian transliteration explicitly. The font name table (nameID 13) confirms OFL 1.1.

brill.licence: Brill Typeface User Licence (non-commercial / personal; web use needs a separate licence)
brill.unavailable: The official page answered HTTP 403 to curl and the download needs a form acceptance, so it was not fetched. Not downloadable by script.
brill.notes: Strong Egyptological coverage in practice, but restricted licence.

umschrift.source: public/UMSCH_*.woff2 in this repo (today's site fonts)
umschrift.licence: unknown (legacy keyboard-mapped font; no Unicode transliteration)
umschrift.notes: Today's title font: keyboard-encoded (Ḥ=O, ꜣ=#, plain o=Ó). No real Unicode transliteration, so coverage is expected to fail.

system-serif.notes: Today's quote font: `font-family: serif` (Times on macOS Chrome). Not a file; coverage depends on the platform.
